description: Create CREDITCOMPANYCLAIM and CREDITCOMPANYCLAIMITEM (OPD credit company claims) if missing
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
preRequisites: Run migration.sql by hand on the database BEFORE deploying any build that contains the CreditCompanyClaim entities (development from #25871 on). The migration page only gets this file in that same build, so it cannot run this step first.
Without these tables every OPD and pharmacy cancel, refund and return is refused.
Idempotent; changes no data. Tables are created in the same case as the existing WEBUSER table.
